**[Critical]** `processMetaLane` fetches new comments for the summary but never records their dedup keys in `dispatchedComments`, causing cross-lane duplication. — Failure scenario: a `review_requested` notification dispatches an envelope containing a comment summary. Those comment IDs are never written to `dispatchedComments`. A subsequent `author`/`comment` notification re-dispatches the same comments in a second aggregate envelope. The bot processes the same comments twice.

```suggestion
const comments = await this.fetchNewComments(
  chatId,
  threadId,
  issueNumber,
  windowSince,
  maxUpdatedAt,
);
const rawBody = meta.body || '';
```

Suggested fix: after `handleInbound` succeeds, record each comment's dedup key:
```ts
for (const c of comments) this.recordDispatched('dispatchedComments', this.commentDedupKey(c));
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`processMetaLane` 拉取评论用于摘要但从不把去重键写入 `dispatchedComments`，导致跨 lane 重复。`review_requested` 下发含评论摘要的 envelope 后，评论 ID 未记录。后续 `author`/`comment` 通知重新下发相同评论。bot 处理两遍。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Critical]** `processMetaLane` dispatches the issue/PR body but never records `dispatchedBodies`, so `tryFirstContactBody` can dispatch the same body a second time. — Failure scenario: bot is assigned to an issue AND a `subscribed` notification for the same thread has `last_read_at: null`. `processMetaLane` dispatches the body. `dispatchedBodies` is NOT updated. `tryFirstContactBody` finds it empty and dispatches the same body again — duplicate envelope.

```suggestion
await this.handleInbound(envelope);
} catch (err) {
  process.stderr.write(
    `[Channel:${this.name}] handleInbound failed for ${kind} ${issueNumber}: ${err}\n`,
```

Suggested fix: record the body key after successful dispatch:
```ts
this.recordDispatched('dispatchedBodies', `${chatId}|${threadId}`);
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`processMetaLane` 下发了 issue/PR body 但从不记录 `dispatchedBodies`，导致 `tryFirstContactBody` 可能重复下发同一 body。bot 被 assign 到 issue 且同线程有 `last_read_at: null` 的 `subscribed` 通知时，meta lane 下发 body 后 tryFirstContactBody 再次下发相同内容。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** The cursor-trim loop covers all three cursor lists (`dispatchedBodies`, `dispatchedComments`, `dispatchedEvents`), but the test `'keeps in-flight dedup keys until the poll succeeds'` only asserts `dispatchedBodies` is trimmed to 500. — Concrete cost: a regression narrowing the trim loop to only `dispatchedBodies` would pass all existing tests while `dispatchedComments` and `dispatchedEvents` grow unbounded.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

游标裁剪循环覆盖三个列表，但测试仅断言 `dispatchedBodies` 被裁剪到 500。如果循环被缩窄为只处理 `dispatchedBodies`，其他列表会无限增长。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**Declined (left open for maintainer).** This scenario requires a `mention` notification whose @bot comment is not in the fetched window (so first-contact feeds the body) together with a `review_requested`/`assign` for the same thread in the same poll batch — a narrow edge whose only consequence is the agent seeing the body twice within one window. The proposed `dispatchedBodies` guard would suppress every future review/assign trigger on a previously-fed thread, which inverts the feature's purpose. We take the narrow duplicate over that regression; a targeted fix (e.g. dedup on `messageId` within a single poll) is better handled in a follow-up so it can be tested in isolation.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**已拒绝（保留待维护者裁定。）** 该场景需要：一条 `mention` 通知但其 @bot 评论不在拉取窗口内（于是首次接触投递 body），同时同一线程在同一轮询批次中又有 `review_requested`/`assign`——这是一个窄边界，唯一后果是 agent 在一个窗口内看到 body 两次。所建议的 `dispatchedBodies` 守卫会在任何已投递过的线程上屏蔽后续所有 review/assign 触发，反转了该特性的目的。我们宁可保留这个窄重复也不要那个回归；一个有针对性的修复（例如在单次轮询内按 `messageId` 去重）更适合放到 follow-up，以便单独测试。

</details>

**P2 — `applyReadHeaders` applied before the result switch**

`applyReadHeaders(res)` is called once before branching on the result kind. If it sets caching headers (e.g. `Cache-Control`), 502 error responses for `cli_unavailable` and `github_prs_failed` would also carry those headers — clients or intermediaries might cache transient errors.

Consider moving `applyReadHeaders` into the `ok` and `not_a_repo` branches only, or verifying that `applyReadHeaders` only sets security/content-type headers that are safe on error responses.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
[P1] Freeze the lease gate until restart

This value is resolved from the current settings on every Config construction. ACP new/load-session paths call `loadSettingsCached` per request, and that cache invalidates when the settings file changes, so toggling this restart-required option immediately affects later sessions while existing sessions retain the old recorder mode. That creates the mixed legacy/leased writer population this rollout gate is intended to prevent: a legacy writer ignores the lock and can still corrupt the transcript. Capture the value at ACP/daemon runtime startup and reuse it until restart, then add a regression test covering a settings change followed by another session creation.
